scope_limit: This proves one Fluff GUI encode on an FS-UAE host-directory volume and Linux full-reader extraction. The mini reader lacks Fluff by design. It does not qualify other payload distributions, resource bounds, Profile 1 with Fluff (which is disallowed), or native OFS/FFS GUI behavior.
